title: Pure GMX
summary: GMX cards with the generic Dinosaurs every GMX Fusion needs, plus generic staples. The page's Yummy Mitsurugi hybrid is left out. GMX Fusions take one GMX monster and Dinosaurs, so the Dinosaurs here are generic ones: Returned Dino Daneen, which was made for GMX, and the classic Oviraptor and Miscellaneousaurus pair. The page's 1.5-card starter runs on this list: Researcher Selande summons Daneen from the Deck, Daneen searches Chairman Kimridge, and Kimridge fetches Applied Experiment #55 to excavate into GMX - VELOX. The Blazing Dominion cards (Partner Selandea, Suppression Squad, Lab #5, the 55th Experiment Report and COMPREX) add extenders, protection and the top boss.
main: GMX Researcher Selande
Normal Summoned: summons a non-Warrior GMX or a Level 3 or lower Dinosaur from the Deck; negates a card next to a Dinosaur Fusion.
GMX Chairman Kimridge
Reveals itself to add Applied Experiment #55; summoned by an effect, stacks two cards and destroys a monster.
GMX Associate Noma
Summoned by an effect: stacks a card from each GY; Fusion Summons when they summon.
GMX Partner Selandea
2026 support. Reveals itself to summon a GMX or Dinosaur from the hand; summoned, revives a Level 4 GMX or Dinosaur.
GMX Suppression Squad
2026 support. Summons itself next to a GMX or Dinosaur and turns a monster into a Dinosaur.
Returned Dino Daneen
Generic Dinosaur made for GMX: summoned by an effect, searches a GMX monster; Fusion Summons a Dinosaur Fusion.
Souleating Oviraptor
Generic Dinosaur: searches or mills a Dinosaur.
Miscellaneousaurus
Limited. Generic Dinosaur: banishes Dinosaurs to summon one of that Level from the Deck.
Petiteranodon
Generic Dinosaur: destroyed, summons a Level 4+ Dinosaur from the Deck.
GMX Applied Experiment #55
Excavates to a GMX and a Dinosaur and Fusion Summons with them.
GMX 55th Experiment Report
2026 support. Quick-Play Dinosaur Fusion, using a GMX from the Deck; from the GY, excavates a GMX card.
GMX Lab #5
2026 support. Field Spell: your GMX summons can't be answered; Sets a GMX Spell/Trap.
Anti-GMX Final Experiment
2026 support. Excavates five to negate an on-field monster effect.
extra: 2026 support. GMX + two or more Dinosaurs: grows with materials and wipes the field when you excavate.
GMX + Dinosaur: excavates on their turn to destroy a card.
GMX + Dinosaur: revives a GMX or Dinosaur; destroys what it battles.
2026 support. Returned Dino Daneen + Dinosaur: searches a GMX card and gains LP when you excavate.
